run.scope: survives = the fish evades the predator (null when the outcome is probabilistic or rests on an unmeasured aerial escape); feasible = an aerial escape is physically available (takeoff check). A kinematic encounter model, not a survival rate. It does not model predator strike kinematics, suction flow, escape direction choice, habituation, schooling, turbidity or light; the larval probability is a measured lookup for one predator (adult zebrafish). Adult zebrafish peak speed is a single-lab mean of 5 fish, applied per SL; other post-larval species borrow it. The aerial distance is the glide.mjs still-air range bound (with ground effect, no taxiing thrust) and says nothing about what the predator does next.

zebrafish-adult.scope: survives = the fish evades the predator (null when the outcome is probabilistic or rests on an unmeasured aerial escape); feasible = an aerial escape is physically available (takeoff check). A kinematic encounter model, not a survival rate. It does not model predator strike kinematics, suction flow, escape direction choice, habituation, schooling, turbidity or light; the larval probability is a measured lookup for one predator (adult zebrafish). Adult zebrafish peak speed is a single-lab mean of 5 fish, applied per SL; other post-larval species borrow it. The aerial distance is the glide.mjs still-air range bound (with ground effect, no taxiing thrust) and says nothing about what the predator does next. Out-of-validity results are reported under out_of_validity and are NOT law violations. STATE comes from the parametric body plan (anatomy-model/parametric), the project growth trajectories (development/) and physiology/ constants. Many inputs are assumed or borrowed from other species; check weakest_input on each field. MORPHOLOGICAL interpolation, not genetic hybridisation (anatomy-model/parametric/design-schema.json): a blended or edited parameter set is a shape, not an organism; it says nothing about whether such an animal could be bred, is viable, or is developmentally reachable.

winged-zebrafish.scope: survives = the fish evades the predator (null when the outcome is probabilistic or rests on an unmeasured aerial escape); feasible = an aerial escape is physically available (takeoff check). A kinematic encounter model, not a survival rate. It does not model predator strike kinematics, suction flow, escape direction choice, habituation, schooling, turbidity or light; the larval probability is a measured lookup for one predator (adult zebrafish). Adult zebrafish peak speed is a single-lab mean of 5 fish, applied per SL; other post-larval species borrow it. The aerial distance is the glide.mjs still-air range bound (with ground effect, no taxiing thrust) and says nothing about what the predator does next. Out-of-validity results are reported under out_of_validity and are NOT law violations. STATE comes from the parametric body plan (anatomy-model/parametric), the project growth trajectories (development/) and physiology/ constants. Many inputs are assumed or borrowed from other species; check weakest_input on each field. MORPHOLOGICAL interpolation, not genetic hybridisation (anatomy-model/parametric/design-schema.json): a blended or edited parameter set is a shape, not an organism; it says nothing about whether such an animal could be bred, is viable, or is developmentally reachable.

wingless-flying-fish.scope: survives = the fish evades the predator (null when the outcome is probabilistic or rests on an unmeasured aerial escape); feasible = an aerial escape is physically available (takeoff check). A kinematic encounter model, not a survival rate. It does not model predator strike kinematics, suction flow, escape direction choice, habituation, schooling, turbidity or light; the larval probability is a measured lookup for one predator (adult zebrafish). Adult zebrafish peak speed is a single-lab mean of 5 fish, applied per SL; other post-larval species borrow it. The aerial distance is the glide.mjs still-air range bound (with ground effect, no taxiing thrust) and says nothing about what the predator does next. Out-of-validity results are reported under out_of_validity and are NOT law violations. STATE comes from the parametric body plan (anatomy-model/parametric), the project growth trajectories (development/) and physiology/ constants. Many inputs are assumed or borrowed from other species; check weakest_input on each field. MORPHOLOGICAL interpolation, not genetic hybridisation (anatomy-model/parametric/design-schema.json): a blended or edited parameter set is a shape, not an organism; it says nothing about whether such an animal could be bred, is viable, or is developmentally reachable.
